googleFullDescription:
Transform your remodeling ideas into real projects with the CECON Remodeling app.

The CECON Remodeling app brings convenient remodeling tools and services together in one place. Explore available products, plan your next project, create estimates, visualize room designs, and communicate with CECON Remodeling directly from your mobile device.

Key features include:

• **Store** — Browse available remodeling products, cabinets, materials, and other products offered by CECON Remodeling.

• **Project Estimator** — Plan your remodeling project and create an estimate based on the type of work, materials, and project options you select.

• **Room Designer** — Explore layouts and plan your space using CECON Remodeling's room design tools.

• **Chat** — Communicate directly with CECON Remodeling when you have questions about products, estimates, designs, or your remodeling project.

Whether you're planning a kitchen renovation, bathroom remodel, cabinetry project, or another home improvement project, the CECON Remodeling app makes it easier to explore your options and begin planning from one convenient place.

Download the CECON Remodeling app and start planning your next project today.
